description: A map of regions shaded by one number each: world countries, US states or European countries. Give a region_set and a list of {id, value}; the server shades every region in one of 3 to 9 equal-interval classes (steps, default 5), draws a legend of the class ranges and hatches the regions that have no value, so a gap never reads as a low number. Colours come from the theme tokens (sequential accent ramp, or a diverging accent2-to-accent ramp through a neutral middle); Viridis, Turbo and other fixed colour maps are not offered. The outlines are bundled with the catalogue (Natural Earth 1:110m for countries, US Census 1:10m for states): there is no custom GeoJSON, so a region that is not in the set cannot be added. A hidden table lists each region with its code, value and class, largest first, and the regions with no value are listed in a details element. A payload that breaks the rules shows a short note instead of a map.
